% !tp-example Basic usage
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcTpLsystem[label=Koch curve]{
  \wcScript[type=tp/lsystem]|
    axiom: F
    iterations: 3
    angle: 60
    rule: F => F+F--F+F
  |
}
\end{document}

% !tp-example Javascript API
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcScript[type=module]|
import "/components/lsystem/lsystem.js";

const example = document.createDocumentFragment();

const element1 = document.createElement("tp-lsystem");
element1.setAttribute("label", "Koch curve");
element1.append(document.createTextNode("\n  "));

const element2 = document.createElement("script");
element2.setAttribute("type", "tp/lsystem");
element2.textContent = "\n    axiom: F\n    iterations: 3\n    angle: 60\n    rule: F => F+F--F+F\n  ";
element1.append(element2);
element1.append(document.createTextNode("\n"));
example.append(element1);

document.body.append(example);
|
\end{document}

% !tp-example Branching tree
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcTpLsystem[src=/docs/components/lsystem/examples/tree.lsys,label=Branching tree]{}
\end{document}

% !tp-example Preset gallery
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcTpGrid[min-width=16rem]{
  \wcTpLsystem[preset=barnsley-fern,label=Barnsley fern]{}
  \wcTpLsystem[preset=dragon-curve,label=Dragon curve]{}
  \wcTpLsystem[preset=sierpinski-triangle,label=Sierpinski triangle]{}
}
\end{document}
